title: HR Manager Salary: Converting Hourly Rates to Annual Pay Under the National Minimum Wage and Awards
description: Learn how to convert an hourly rate to annual salary for HR managers, including the 38-hour week, fortnightly pay, tax, and super. Uses Fair Work and ABS data.
salarySummary: The median full-time HR manager salary is $2,768 per week based on a 45-hour week, but for standard conversion we assume 38 hours per week.

faqs.q: How is annual salary calculated from an hourly rate?
faqs.a: Annual gross = hourly rate × hours per week × 52. For a 38-hour week, multiply hourly by 1976. For the national minimum wage ($26.44), that gives $52,285.60 per year before tax and super.

faqs.q: What is the national minimum wage from 1 July 2026?
faqs.a: The National Minimum Wage is $26.44 per hour, $1,004.90 per week for a 38 hours, or $33.05 per hour for casual employees including 25% loading. Award rates increase by 4.75% from that date.

faqs.q: What is the median hr manager salary in Australia?
faqs.a: According to the Australian Bureau of Statistics, the median full-time HR manager earns $2,768 per week ($75 per hour) based on a 45-hour week. For a standard 38-hour week, that would be approximately $2,338 per week or $121,000 per year.

bodyMarkdown:
## Understanding the National Minimum Wage vs. Award Rates

The Fair Work Ombudsman sets the National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026 at $26.44 per hour or $1,004.90 per week for a 38-hour week. Most employees are covered by a modern award, which sets minimum pay rates for their industry or occupation. For example, the Human Resource Manager occupation falls under the *Business Equipment Award* or a similar award. Award minimum wages increase by 4.75% from 1 July 2026. The pay guides from the Fair Work Ombudsman list the exact rates for each classification.

## Converting Hourly to Annual Pay

To convert an hourly rate to an annual salary, use the formula:

**Annual gross ≈ hourly × hours per week × 52**

We assume a standard 38-hour week unless otherwise stated. For a full-time HR manager, the median weekly earnings are $2,768 per week, but that is based on a 45-hour week, tax would be approximately $37,000 plus Medicare, leaving around $103,000 after tax.

## Using the Timesheet and Other Tools

Our [the timesheet](/) lets you enter your base hourly rate and optionally add 25% casual loading. It calculates annual, fortnightly, and weekly amounts with super and tax. For more detailed award rates, see [pay guides](/blog) or [reference tables](/data). For minimum wage topics, see [minimum wage](/).

## Conclusion

Whether you are an HR manager checking your salary or an employer setting a salary, understanding the conversion and the difference between the National Minimum Wage, award rates, casual loading, and super is essential. The median HR manager salary is $2,768 per week for a 45-hour week, but for standard conversion we assume 38 hours. Always check the relevant award or enterprise agreement for your exact rate.
